name: Anaheim
living: the twin waterfalls tumble down the rock formation (a slow scrolling shimmer on the painted water)
mist sparkles softly at the base of the falls where the water meets the rocks
palm fronds on the rockpile sway gently in a warm breeze
the red pennant flags on the giant cap gates flutter lazily
small white pixel clouds drift slowly across the blue sky (sky layer drift)
a sun glint slides across the glass skyscraper windows
light-tower lamp banks glow with a soft daytime shimmer
a seagull or two glides across the sky now and then
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
a home run sends a burst of water spray up the waterfall
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
